scenario: [LGRA.2.9.6.4]: a timestamp spec on a value that is not a `Time` is refused with DS_VALIDATE_INTERP_BAD_FORMAT. Pin: `{e.n:%Y}` on an Int slot — the pattern is a sentence of [LGRA.2.9.6.1]'s grammar, so the refusal is the kind check in `dsc.validate.lgra_2_9_6_5_refusals`'s TIME_SPEC arm and not the grammar. An Int holding epoch nanoseconds is still an Int.
rules_ds:
schema E scope logical:
    id: Int key
    n: Int mutable

rule r:
    E e
->
    log info "year {e.n:%Y}"
